subject: 英语
source: 人教版PEP小学英语（三年级起点）教材单元话题整理
original_text:
【核心词汇】duck 鸭子; pig 猪; cat 猫; bear 熊; dog 狗; elephant 大象; monkey 猴子; bird 鸟; tiger 老虎; panda 熊猫; zoo 动物园
【重点句型】What's this? 这是什么？ It's a ... 它是一只…… What's that? 那是什么？ Cool! I like it. 酷！我喜欢它。 Look! A funny dog! 看！一只滑稽的狗！
【A Let's talk】Mike: What's this? Zoom: It's a duck. Mike: What's that? Zoom: It's a panda. Mike: Look! A funny dog! Zoom: Cool! I like it.
【Read and write】Look at the cat. It is fat. Look at the pig. It is big. Look at the dog. It is on the log. Look at the duck. It is in the truck. Look at the bear. It is on the pear.
key_points: Cool! I like it. 酷！我喜欢它。
Look! A funny dog! 看！一只滑稽的狗！
cautions: 只做内容骨架（核心词汇、重点句型、对话与短文范例），不生成老师逐字讲解稿；词汇与句型均依据该 PEP 单元目标语言整理，不得编造教材未出现的单词、语法点或例句。
